Connect a live TransForm feed

Live Data pulls WCCCD_CLERY submissions from the TransForm REST API through your Google Apps Script proxy. Paste the proxy URL below, or set CONFIG.proxyUrl near the top of this file to bake it in. The endpoint should return a JSON array of submissions, or an object with the array under rows, data, records or submissions. The same URL relays AI requests, so the Gemini key stays in Script Properties and never touches this file.
